simple.meaning: אֹזֶן (ʼôzen) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “broadness . i.e. (concrete) the ear (from its form in man).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 188 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 11 more, beginning at Genesis 20:8. Its contexts include city, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֹזֶן (H241).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: אֹזֶן (ʼôzen) / H241 is traced through Genesis 20:8, Genesis 23:10, Genesis 23:13, Genesis 23:16 as a generated source-based concept entry.

Let your ear now be attentive, and your eyes open, that you may listen to the prayer of your servant, which I pray before you at this time, day and night, for the children of Israel your servants, while I confess the sins of the children of Israel, which we have sinned against you.
